A small, defined starting point

One workflow. One useful report.

The pilot tests whether a repeatable reporting process is useful for your firm before investing in integrations.

01 / Agree the inputs

Start with one export format

Review your current reporting process, agree the reporting period and metric definitions, and choose a ticket CSV format. Use anonymized examples to assess fit.

02 / Prepare a draft

Make the work understandable

Prepare a draft covering ticket activity, recurring issues, supplied monitoring findings, and proposed follow-up. Show gaps explicitly.

03 / Review and share

Your team approves the story

Confirm the facts, business impact, recommendations, and client decisions. Share the approved report through your usual process.

Before you start

A few practical questions.

Do you need access to our systems?

The initial pilot is designed around agreed exports. Direct integrations are a later decision, based on what your workflow needs.

Is this already a self-service reporting app?

No. This is a pilot offer and sample deliverable. Report processing, data handling, and delivery are agreed with each pilot firm before work begins.

Can you report on backups, security, or uptime?

Only when the necessary evidence is supplied and the metric definition is agreed. Missing information is labeled as unavailable. Completed backup jobs alone do not establish successful recovery.

Who reviews the report?

Your team verifies findings, recommendations, client impact, and any costs before sending it to a client. Drafts are not sent automatically.
